chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad narrated from Ahmad ibn Ishaq from Sa'dan from Abu Baseer from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
There is nothing which the Angels attend except for the pledge (of a contest) and the playing of the man with his wife.

key_terms.أَهْلَهُ: His wife (specifically in the context of marital relations)
key_terms.الرِّهَانَ: Pledge or stake in a contest/game

ai.seo_question: What two things do Angels attend according to this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) identifies the pledge (risan) in recreational contests and marital intimacy as the only two activities attended by angels, highlighting their spiritual dimension. In Shia jurisprudence, this underscores the permissibility and blessed nature of these acts when conducted with proper intent, distinguishing them from other worldly engagements that may lack such divine presence.
